name: chrome-remote-debugging
title: Chrome Remote Debugging
description: Auto-click Chrome's "Allow remote debugging?" prompt in the background, toggled like Coffee.
author: AceroM

commands.name: status
commands.title: Remote Debugging Status
commands.subtitle: Chrome Remote Debugging
commands.description: Menu bar item showing whether the auto-allow watcher is running.

commands.name: toggle
commands.title: Toggle Remote Debugging Auto-Allow
commands.subtitle: Chrome Remote Debugging
commands.description: Start or stop the watcher that clicks Allow on Chrome's remote debugging prompt.

preferences.name: interval
preferences.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
preferences.description: How often to look for the prompt.

preferences.name: hideWhenInactive
preferences.label: Hide menu bar icon when stopped
preferences.description: Only show the menu bar icon while the watcher is running.
